description: Twelve publication packages describe Alberta road restrictions due to construction, maintenance or seasonal conditions. Eleven provide dated PDF orders for 2004–2014, while the annual-list package returns PDF summaries for 2014–2024 and a link to earlier orders. Individual order descriptors include effective dates and times. This is a curated historical road-operating restriction family, not a current traffic feed or complete list of all restrictions. Some order sequences have gaps or repeated numbers, so continuity and complete within-year coverage are not asserted. Road locations, load limits and numerical restrictions require the unfetched documents. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the original source identity and metadata. Source coverage is Alberta unless the described component explicitly includes Canada. The native licence field states Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs are unverified. No linked dataset, document, workbook, archive, installer, code or legal text was fetched. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown.
